searchText: Full summary, assets, decisions, and recording: https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acdc/186 https://forkcast.org/calls/acdc/186/ eipsinsight has the full recording, heads up forkcast the recording is cut off in the beginning, stefan's updates not there and thank you guys both for your work, i rely on these sites every week! note for eipinsights, would be nice to have the call transcript copyable both are using the same youtube stream which started late dute to technical hiccup. forkcast has but trims the transcript/chat logs before the video actually kicks on - usually its just banter, but in this case theres some of the actual call contents missing. ill look into handling the edge case differently.
